description.message: Brings the names of the items of your Amazon orders into Michelito, from your order pages.

linkLead.message: In Michelito, go to Settings → Amazon extension, make a code and paste it here.

walkLead.message: Opens your Amazon orders in a tab, page by page and slowly, and sends Michelito only each order's number and its item names.

walkSignIn.message: You need to be signed in to amazon.com in this Chrome.

running.message: Reading your orders… page $FIRST$. You can close this window.

done.message: Done: $FIRST$ orders with names ($SECOND$ already have their email in Michelito).

doneFailed.message: $FIRST$ orders could not be read from the pages.

unlinkLead.message: To cut access on the server, use Revoke in Michelito's Settings.

error_bad_code.message: That code does not work. Make a new one in Settings and paste it within 10 minutes.

error_rate_limited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.

error_signed_out.message: Amazon asked you to sign in. Sign in to amazon.com and try again.

error_unlinked.message: The extension is no longer linked (it was revoked in Settings). Link it with a new code.

error_timeout.message: Amazon took too long to load. Try again.

error_server.message: Michelito could not save the names. Try again later.

error_running.message: Your orders are already being read.
